mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.unified_auth_id, i.git_name, i.source, i.evidence_commit, i.evidence_at, i.verified_at from users u join user_ssh_keys k on k.user_id = u.user_id left join user_scm_git_identities i on i.user_id = u.user_id where u.status = 'ACTIVE' and (#{afterUserId} is null or u.user_id > #{afterUserId}) order by u.user_id limit #{limit}
mapper.insert:
insert into user_scm_git_identities as current_identity( user_id, git_name, source, evidence_commit, evidence_at, verified_at, created_at, updated_at ) values
(#{row.userId}, #{row.gitName}, #{row.source}, #{row.evidenceCommit}, #{row.evidenceAt}, #{row.verifiedAt}, #{now}, #{now})
on conflict (user_id) do update set git_name = excluded.git_name, source = excluded.source, evidence_commit = excluded.evidence_commit, evidence_at = excluded.evidence_at, verified_at = excluded.verified_at, updated_at = excluded.updated_at where current_identity.source = 'ACCEPTED_COMMIT_HISTORY' and ( (current_identity.evidence_at, coalesce(current_identity.evidence_commit, '')) < (excluded.evidence_at, coalesce(excluded.evidence_commit, '')) or ( current_identity.evidence_at = excluded.evidence_at and coalesce(current_identity.evidence_commit, '') = coalesce(excluded.evidence_commit, '') and current_identity.git_name <> excluded.git_name ) )
